scope.purpose: Validate whether the nine-item master inventory is a full universe coverage or a subset, using repository sources only.

Recovered queue explicitly contains a reconstructed sequence and a conflicting alternative, proving it is a control asset rather than an exhaustive universe census.
Production queue gives a deterministic selection policy for Batch 005 only; it is not a universe inventory.

reasoning: The nine listed items are only subject-level control rows recovered from batch and queue assets.
Repository sources show additional narrative loci in holds, reviews, and corpus-wide authority material that are not represented as one of the nine rows.
Therefore the artifact is a subset inventory, not a complete universe census.

reconstructed_full_universe_model.representative_scope_note: This audit only proves the current inventory is incomplete; it does not attempt to claim a closed final list beyond the repository evidence recovered here.

audit_conclusion.action_required: Expand the universe model before any claim of exhaustive coverage or permanent lock based solely on the nine-item list.
